_doc: PROPOSAL (task M3-01), not game data. Planet restoration and the ending (spec section 9), unchanged from the spec. A district's value is stage_values[its stage] plus the step to the next value times how far it is toward the next stage (share of hexes at the next stage or above, over districts.json stage_share). Planet restoration is the mean over the listed districts. The ending fires once when every district is at ending.stage.
